title: Field extension: variable
description: The field bound to a variable, by its name — a value given elsewhere, a test matrix's, the field keeping its own outside it —, in the strip under the field: its icon, lit while bound, the name shown; pressed, the name written; emptied, unbound. An extension holding a value of its own (`value`): sent back beside the field's, under `<field>__variable`, the field's value never touched.

value.description: The name the field is bound to; null, none. An extension carrying `value` holds a value of its own, sent back under `<field>__<extension>`.

pattern.description: A regular expression a name matches: one word, a letter first, unless said.

label.description: What the name is, said by the glyph and the field: « Test variable ».

suggestions.description: The names already in use, offered as one writes.
